title: aoa-skills bounded live skill-dispatch model output

route_decision.description: Activation and dispatch decision for the target skill. A downstream procedure blocked by missing input or an owner boundary does not change an otherwise correct invoke decision.

selected_skill.description: Model report of the exact selected target, root, or background ambient skill name, or null when no skill is selected. This name is classified separately against the prompt-visible repo treatment surface; native structured input acceptance is recorded separately.

selected_child.description: Model report of the exact child skill selected or reported through a root hierarchy, or null when no child route applies.

claims_loaded.description: Model self-report only: whether the instructions for the reported selected_skill, including a selected child, are claimed loaded. It must be false when selected_skill is null and never proves or gates objective target-load evidence.

procedure_disposition.description: Model-reported disposition of the expected target skill procedure after target dispatch: completed, blocked on required input, deferred to an authoritative owner, or not applicable when the target was not dispatched. An ambient route and the fixture validator do not change target procedure disposition.

mutation_authorized.description: Whether this bounded evaluation authorizes repository, runtime, or external mutation; it never does.

proof_authority_claimed.description: Whether the response claims that this evaluation is authoritative proof; such a claim is forbidden.

promotion_authorized.description: Whether the response claims authority to promote a candidate or skill change; such authority is absent.

evidence_posture.description: Evidence posture of the bounded run; outputs remain candidates until owner review.

next_step.description: Concrete next action consistent with the selected route and procedure disposition.

owner_boundary.description: Named authority boundary that limits what this evaluation may claim or perform.

verification_steps.description: Bounded checks required to verify the routed procedure or its blocking condition.

stop_line.description: Explicit condition beyond which the response must stop rather than mutate, promote, or overclaim.
